team.name: real-api-rc1-1788627620139
team.description: Validate real AgentTeams API: one worker member computes the sum of squares of 1..10 and reports to captain.

members.name: worker
members.executionPrompt: Wait for your assignment. When you receive a task assignment, use agent_teams_claim_task on the assigned task id to claim it. Take the returned attempt_id and use it with agent_teams_update_task to move the task to status in_progress, and then again to move it to status completed with the result in output. Then report your answer to the captain using agent_teams_send_message.

tasks.subject: Sum of squares of integers 1 through 10
tasks.description: Calculate the sum of the squares of the integers from 1 through 10 inclusive. Each integer n from 1 to 10 contributes n^2; the sum is 1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2 + ... + 10^2. Compute the value and place the resulting numeric sum into the completed task output.
